newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek mutual fund assets rise to 3.72trn drs in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Greek mutual fund assets rise to 3.72trn drs in Nov.

text.p: Greece's mutual fund industry numbering 150 mutual funds saw assets under management rise 4.39 percent in November hitting 3.72 trillion drachmas, the Union of Institutional Investors said in its monthly review.
Total fund assets amounted to 3.56 trillion at end-October.
Since the beginning of the year, the mutual fund industry has witnessed growth of 46.2 percent -- 1.28 trillion drachmas -- in assets under management.
Three new mutual funds, Alpha Steady Income, Interamerican Money Market and ATE textiles-footwear-apparel, joined the group of 147 funds.
In November, the industry's fixed income group saw assets rise 7.94 percent on October while growth in money market fund assets was more pronounced, up 13.95 percent.
Bucking the trend were balanced funds which saw assets drop by 6.0 percent and equity growth funds, hit with a sharper decrease of 11.5 percent.
Based on assets under management, fixed income and money market funds made up 94.9 percent of the industry while balanced and equity funds a mere 3.3 percent.
